value.rationale: This is a natural complete initial-range evaluation (n=1..16) of the first nonbinary alphabet for a named minimax invariant introduced for general k in arXiv:2406.02971, where only the binary table was computed. The result includes all maximally dispersed ternary words up to symbol relabeling and exact gaps from general bounds; it supplies reproducible benchmark data for future algorithms and extremal-construction study. No significance is inferred from correctness or code alone and no unsupported infinite theorem is asserted.
